registryBasis: The official DRC Ministry of Land Affairs directory documents 143 land/cadastral circonscriptions and lists Lualaba and Lubudi among the covered administrative areas. The official public-service catalogue documents consultation of cadastral and real-estate registers through the Conservateur des Titres Immobiliers or Chef de Division du Cadastre. This evidences relevant registry custody and procedure, but not an open Fungurume parcel geometry service.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: National DRC land/cadastral registry and the Ministry directory of provincial/local circonscriptions; Fungurume-specific parcel coverage was not published or verified.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official Ministry directory loaded. It lists Lualaba and Lubudi circonscriptions, but no Fungurume parcel layer, service URL, schema, or geometry endpoint was exposed.
Official public-service page loaded. It describes formal register consultation and delivery of a signed parcel-information record; it does not expose anonymous parcel geometry.
Formal land-search workflow is application-based and includes unsafe identity/title fields; no request was submitted and no such fields were queried.
Non-government BIC site advertises a digital cadastral platform and data for 26 provinces, but no public Fungurume parcel response or documented anonymous geometry endpoint was established.
Public ArcGIS item search returned total=0; this is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
